faqs.q: How can I verify the purity of Shilajit Resin at home?
faqs.a: 1) Solubility test: A pea-sized drop dissolves completely in warm water into a reddish-black/golden liquid with zero sand at the bottom. 2) Temperature test: It hardens when cold and softens in warm hands. 3) Flame test: Pure Shilajit does not catch fire like candle wax or sugar; it bubbles and turns to ash.
